title: Oven Baked Middle Eastern Wheat Harees
description: A traditional Middle Eastern dish featuring wheat and Marmite, baked to perfection in the oven, this recipe is macrobiotic-friendly and has a unique flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the wheat berries and water, and let it soak for 30 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
In a large robata grill or oven-safe vessel, combine the soaked wheat berries, cooked onion and garlic, Marmite, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Cover the vessel with a lid or aluminum foil, and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the lid or foil, and continue baking for an additional 15 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove the harees from the oven, and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
